senses.gloss: to vibrate; to have a clear ring.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:6:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ולא היה מְצַלְצֵל וכ׳</he> and it had not the clear ring as before.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 17:5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XVII</cite> <he>ומְצַלְצֶלֶת בכפיה</he> she clapped with her hands (in joy); (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 232:2">Yalk. Kings 232</cite> <he>ומסלסלת בכפי ידיה</he>).
